title: Rebuild1
note: The first gathering for European social platforms. Hosted in Copenhagen, it became the first seed in an expanding movement.

title: Social Need Framework
note: Built during Rebuild1, the Social Need Framework is a tool for social platforms to identify and prioritise the social needs they address.

title: Social Design Framework
note: The Social Design Framework is a tool for social platforms to audit and design their services and products in a way that leverages best practices and decades of knowledge on how to design for social.

title: Rebuild2
note: The second gathering for European social platforms. Hosted in Helsinki, it turned mobilisation into action and knowledge sharing with a summer camp format.

title: European Social Platform Directory
note: The Social Platform Directory lists every European social platform there is.

title: Ecosystem Platform
note: The Ecosystem Platform is the next iteration of Rebuild's digital presence, providing a blueprint and platform for continental ecosystem formation within the social platform sector and beyond.

title: Investor Whitepaper
note: A first of its kind whitepaper outlining the investment opportunities and strategies for European social platforms.

title: Investor & Journalist Mobilisation
note: The mobilisation of investors and journalists to support the European social platform sector.

title: European Social Platform Economy Analysis
note: A first of its kind analysis of the European social platform economy, providing insights into the sector's size and growth potential.

title: Directing European Funding
note: Helping to direct European funding towards social platforms.

title: Rebuild3
note: The third gathering for European social platforms. Hosted in Paris, it will be a showcase of the platforms and mark the end of Rebuild as an organisation, but not as a movement.

title: Facilitation of a European Social Platform Industry Organisation
note: The facilitation of a European Social Platform Industry Organisation to support the sector's growth and development.
